stem_book: A system of 10 balls each of mass 2 kg are connected via massless and unstretchable string. The system is allowed to slip over the edge of a smooth table as shown in figure. Tension on the string between the 7th and 8th ball is ____ N when the 6th ball just leaves the table. (g = 10 m/s²)
work: 6 balls hanging: a = 6g/10 = 6 m/s² ; T₇₈ pulls balls 8–10 (6 kg) on table → T = 6·6 = 36 N
